crossRefs.note: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,
He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.
translations.bsb: Nicodemus, who had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
translations.kjv: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound
translations.asv: And there came also Nicodemus, he who at the first came to him by night, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds.
